Name: Second Harvest of Silicon Valley
About: Second Harvest of Silicon Valley provides free nutritious groceries and fresh meals to families, seniors, and individuals experiencing food insecurity in Santa Clara and San Mateo counties.

Name: Rocket Dog Rescue
About: Rocket Dog Rescue saves abused, neglected, and abandoned dogs from overcrowded shelters and places them into loving, permanent homes.

Name: Birthfund
About: Birthfund provides financial grants for midwifery care, lactation support, and postpartum resources to help families facing financial hardship achieve safe and dignified births.

Name: Sunday Friends
About: Sunday Friends helps low-income families break the intergenerational cycle of poverty and achieve health equity by providing them with educational programs, financial literacy, and basic necessities.

Name: Wikipedia
About: Wikipedia provides free access to a comprehensive compendium of human knowledge to benefit and educate readers around the world.

Name: The Trevor Project
About: The Trevor Project provides suicide prevention and mental health services to support and protect LGBTQ+ young people.

Name: Sierra Club
About: The Sierra Club helps people and communities by defending everyone's right to a healthy world, protecting wild places and ecosystems, and fighting for clean air, clean water, and solutions to the climate crisis.
